observations.why: The speaker enacts a decisional stance — declaring a switch as settled rather than proposing it — performing authority over the group's direction.
The justification is framed entirely in proportional cost-benefit terms — performance multiplier and price reduction — the classic market-pricing register.
Stated as a titled directive, not a proposal; the bolded heading format enacts a command-structure register consistent with authority-ranking.
Quantified proportional gain presented as a benefit metric — proportionality framing characteristic of market-pricing.
Setting a timeline is an authority move — allocating a temporal constraint the group is expected to meet, enacting rank-based coordination.
